subject: Materials Science
title: Partial Dislocations
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Partial Dislocations.

hook.text: A dislocation doesn't always move in one piece — sometimes it splits in two, like a zipper opening.

buildup.text: A full dislocation can split into two partial dislocations separated by a stacking fault ribbon.

discovery.text: Shockley partials carry a fraction of the full Burgers vector — they're energetically cheaper.

twist.text: Wide splitting makes cross-slip harder — that's why low stacking fault energy metals work-harden fast.

climax.text: Stainless steel's low stacking fault energy keeps partials wide, boosting toughness and formability.

punchline.text: A split dislocation moves differently — and that changes everything.
